headline: When is it Time to Call for Fire Damage Repair?
articleBody: It can be really tough to know when you're facing fire damage that's too big to handle yourself. Sometimes, even what looks like a small fire can leave behind major issues. Here are some key signs that it’s definitely time to bring in the pros from First To Respond Restoration: you notice a lingering smoke odor even after airing out the property; smoke particles are tiny and can get into everything, causing ongoing smells and damage. There's visible soot or ash on surfaces, especially on walls, ceilings, or personal items; this stuff is corrosive and needs specialized cleaning. Any signs of structural damage like warped beams, cracked walls, or compromised roofing, which can make your home unsafe. If there was a lot of water used to put out the fire, you'll need water extraction and drying to prevent mold growth. Or, if you simply feel overwhelmed and don't know where to start. We've got over 25 years of experience handling all types of fire damage, big or small, for homes and businesses across the San Fernando Valley. Don't hesitate, give us a call 24/7 to secure your property and start the restoration process right.
